context: Orin is waiting in the Bhaal Temple with the party’s abducted companion strung up on an altar (if no valid companion was available she instead abducted Yenna or a random citizen) and has given the players a brutal ultimatum: kill Gortash and return his Netherstone or the captive will be sacrificed. Her lines react to many off‑screen flags — whether you killed Gortash, attacked Orin during her impersonations, are Unholy Assassins or Dark Urge, kidnapped a romance or friend, killed Sarevok, or warned her of your arrival (in which case the victim may already be dead) — and she gleefully taunts the player with claims of forgotten memories placing the player as the former Chosen and herself as subordinate. Orin delights in threatening the victim, insists on a formal duel (one‑on‑one), and will escalate into violence: she transforms into the Slayer and combat begins; if you are Dark Urge there is a special DU duel option. The outcome of the fight carries post‑combat consequences (including Bhaal’s intervention if Orin or the player falls).
